summary: Icons: check whether every Icon parses its SVG again (share them if so)

comments.author: x74qtb63
comments.body: Checked 2026-10-19 (Svg.Controls.Skia.Avalonia 12.0.0.17, by reflection): the parsed-picture cache (_cache, EnableCache) is per Svg instance, not shared, so every Icon does parse its own file. But the parse runs in ReloadSourceAsync (off the UI thread), and a shared SvgSource goes through CreateWorkingSource, which looks like a copy per control, so sharing it may not save the parse. Not changed blindly: needs a dotnet-trace of a list scroll first. Left in Backlog.
